column4: First attempt: host 21 lost its MDM connection to host 22 because the clones share a Windows MDM hardware ID. Rebuilding the golden image with sysprep /generalize and rerunning E-1, E-2, then W-1.

doWipePersistProvisionedData wiped host 23 (lab1 profile and marker file gone) and kept fleet-agent-b-plain.ppkg in ProgramData\Microsoft\Provisioning. The reset Windows then never booted in UTM (Start boot option hang, Startup Repair with 0 root causes, error 0xc0000001 after bcdboot), so re-enrollment could not be observed. Lab limit: Windows 11 26H2 arm64 reset under UTM/QEMU.
